description: Perform an on-page SEO health audit for https://books.toscrape.com/. 1. Crawl the website. 2. Navigate to the 'Page Titles' tab, analyze issues, and export the data to a CSV in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ (filename must contain 'title'). 3. Navigate to the 'Meta Description' tab, analyze issues, and export the data to a CSV in ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ (filename must contain 'description'). 4. Write a summary report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/onpage_audit_report.txt containing the total page count, count of missing descriptions, and at least one recommendation.
